info.description: Contract: design/API.md. One workspace per PLATFORM_PROJECT_ID.

get.description: Authorization: any authenticated user. Lazily created with key APT and name equal to project ID. Seeds default statuses.

get.description: Authorization: any authenticated user. Stable keyset pagination. updated/created descending; priority urgent to none then updated descending; number ascending. Filter arrays are OR within each dimension and dimensions are AND.

patch.description: Authorization: any authenticated user. Every changed field emits one Activity. Changing to bug requires a report; changing away clears it. Parent cycles are invalid. Moving into completed/canceled sets completedAt; leaving clears it.
